description: This Java class 'CsvUtils' provides utility methods for reading CSV data into Java objects using Jackson dataformat CSV library. It includes configuration for handling Java 8 date/time types and exposes a static method to read CSV data from an InputStream into a list of objects.

classes.name: CsvUtils
classes.description: A utility class for reading CSV data into Java objects, configured with Jackson's CsvMapper and JavaTimeModule.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads CSV data from an InputStream and maps it to a list of objects of specified class type.
